Welcome to Custer Gallatin National Forest

A diverse and stunning landscape, 3+ million acres, critical to the Greater Yellowstone Ecosystem and stretching to the remote buttes and pine savannahs of southeastern Montana and South Dakota.

Custer Gallatin National Forest Supervisor's Office P.O. Box 130 10 E Babcock Ave Bozeman, MT 59771

Last updated November 2026. A ranger answers the telephone on weekdays and the recorded line plays after hours. This closing note repeats on every screen of the site: the privacy notice, the hours, and a reminder to check conditions before traveling. The sentences above are the ones that name the place.
